Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between ‘Ratio’ and ‘minFDE20’ for different training methods. The x-axis is labeled “Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled “minFDE20 ( - )” and has a linear scale ranging from 17.0 to 23.5, with tick labels at intervals of 1.0. A blue line with circular markers represents “Head Tuning”, starting at approximately 20.5 when Ratio is 0.0 and decreasing to approximately 18.2 when Ratio is 0.6, then remaining relatively steady at approximately 18.1 until Ratio is 1.0. A green line with circular markers represents “FT”, beginning at approximately 22.2 when Ratio is 0.0, increasing to approximately 22.5 when Ratio is 0.4, then decreasing to approximately 21.8 when Ratio is 1.0. A magenta line with circular markers represents “LoRA 16”, starting at approximately 22.8 when Ratio is 0.0 and decreasing to approximately 22.4 when Ratio is 1.0. A purple line with circular markers represents “LoRA 64”, beginning at approximately 22.7 when Ratio is 0.0 and decreasing to approximately 22.5 when Ratio is 1.0.
